title: meter as a sensor
symptom: Meter data is not being treated as sensor readings; it is tagged as calibration data, so it does not appear on graphs, in CSV exports, or in Nightscout calculations.
evidence_quote: I'm using a contour next one bluetooth meter. My readings go into both xdrip and nightscout, but don't show up on either graph because I believe both xdrip and nightscout are tagging them calibrations not glucose readings.
